units.source_scale_reason: Guides are the accepted paintings at their accepted scale; every video frame keeps one fixed extraction scale and anchor.

visual_review.notes: Accepted 2026-10-11 from complete 124-frame review sheets, close-ups of every fast passage, loop seams and the native 128 px battle overview. idle: guarded breathing loop, pike tips forward and returns, every second frame at 60 ms (no RIFE needed). move: one full march-in-place gait cycle, seam 60->0 matches. attack: pike swings down to level, step and full-reach thrust (contact at video 54), recovery to ready. hit: hit_h3_v2 recoil and recovery. defend: shield raised, crouch, held guard. cast: pike planted, hand slides up to a high rally grip, held, lowered. death: death_h3_v2 knees buckle, forward fall, pike falls head-right in front of the body. Rejected: hit_h3_v1 (plate drifted blue to red and black over video frames 48-109); death_h3_v1 (painted death_36 holds the pike head up-left while death_39 lays it head-right, so the pike turned end over end through the body; v2 drops death_36).
